def slugify(text):
    """Convert text into a URL-friendly slug.

    The text is lowercased and trimmed, then every run of characters outside
    ``a-z0-9`` is replaced with a single hyphen and leading/trailing hyphens
    are removed.

    Args:
        text: The string to convert.

    Returns:
        The slugified string, or an empty string if ``text`` contains no
        alphanumeric characters.
    """
    text = text.lower().strip()
